findings.explanation: HOL4's only clause is dest_Refv (Refv v) = v. It is a one-constructor-pattern definition, so it goes through non_wfrec_defn and Prim_rec.new_recursive_definition (Defn.sml:1182, new_specification at Prim_rec.sml:281). That saves only the clause, with no ARB completion, so values on W8array, Varray and Thunk stay open. Lean's catch-all `| _ => ARB` proves dest_Refv (W8array ws) = ARB, and hence dest_Refv (W8array []) = dest_Refv (Varray []). HOL4's specification implies neither equation.
findings.repair:
noncomputable opaque dest_Refv_unspec {α : Type} [Nonempty α] : store_v α → α

def dest_Refv [Nonempty α] : store_v α → α
  | Refv v => v
  | s => dest_Refv_unspec s
findings.lean_check:
import CmlTS.SemanticPrimitivesProps
open CmlTS

example : dest_Refv (store_v.W8array [] : store_v Nat) = dest_Refv (store_v.Varray [] : store_v Nat) := rfl
example : dest_Refv (store_v.W8array [] : store_v Nat) = ARB := rfl
findings.hol4_check: ?f:num store_v -> num. (!v. f (Refv v) = v) /\ f (W8array []) <> f (Varray [])

findings.explanation: HOL4's FV_dec_def has clauses only for Dlet, Dletrec, Dtype, Dtabbrev and Dexn. All are one-constructor patterns, so it is made by Prim_rec.new_recursive_definition (new_specification), which saves just these clauses without ARB. FV_dec on Dmod, Dlocal and Denv is left open. Lean's catch-all `| _ => ARB` proves FV_dec (Dmod mn ds) = ARB, FV_dec (Denv n) = ARB, and hence FV_dec (Dmod mn ds) = FV_dec (Denv n). HOL4's saved theorem implies none of these.
findings.repair:
noncomputable opaque FV_dec_unspec : dec → Set (ident modN varN)

def FV_dec : dec → Set (ident modN varN)
  | Dlet _ p e => FV (exp.Mat e [(p, exp.Lit ARB)])
  | Dletrec _ defs => FV (exp.Letrec defs (exp.Lit ARB))
  | Dtype _ _ => ∅
  | Dtabbrev _ _ _ _ => ∅
  | Dexn _ _ _ => ∅
  | d => FV_dec_unspec d
findings.lean_check:
import CmlTS.SemanticPrimitivesProps
open CmlTS

example (mn : modN) (ds : List dec) (n : tvarN) : FV_dec (dec.Dmod mn ds) = FV_dec (dec.Denv n) := rfl
example (n : tvarN) : FV_dec (dec.Denv n) = ARB := rfl
findings.hol4_check: ?f. (!l p e. f (Dlet l p e) = FV (Mat e [(p,Lit ARB)])) /\ (!l defs. f (Dletrec l defs) = FV (Letrec defs (Lit ARB))) /\ (!l t. f (Dtype l t) = {}) /\ (!l a b c. f (Dtabbrev l a b c) = {}) /\ (!l a b. f (Dexn l a b) = {}) /\ f (Dmod mn ds) <> f (Denv n)
